WATCH_PRICE_BANDS._comment: Rough [low, avg, high] used resale $ per watch brand - sanity clamp on the AI's estimated_resale_value for the 'watches' category, not a precise valuation. Real live miss: 3 Movado listings alerted off AI resale guesses of $595-795 while real eBay/WatchCharts comps for those exact models (Bold/Museum/Series 800/Edge) cluster $150-550. Scraped from watchcharts.com (free, no-login) Aug 2026 where noted 'scraped'; brands not scraped there use rough market-knowledge ballparks marked 'estimated' - fine for this purpose since the gate only needs to catch estimates that are wildly (multiples) off, not be exact.
